name: Troll Tale
source:
The game follows Askeladden as he faces a troll. Follow him in a traditionally norweagian tale where the moral is to stay clever.

[From [url=https://jenstercreations.itch.io/troll-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏讲述了阿斯克拉登直面巨魔的故事。跟随他的脚步，走进这则寓意着“时刻保持机智”的挪威传统民间故事吧。

[引自[url=https://jenstercreations.itch.io/troll-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
